description: Land Acquisition - Maligaspe, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galla District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically the revocation of a land acquisition order under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific land parcels, their boundaries, and legal procedures related to land ownership and acquisition. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content focuses on land redemption and property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
